desc: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects. It must be stored in a jar or flask that has been coated inside with @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgOilOfSlipperi]{Oil of Slipperiness}. When found, a container contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.

One ounce of the glue can cover a 1-foot square surface. Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set. Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgUniversalSolv]{Universal Solvent} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgOilOfEthereal]{Oil of Etherealness}, or with a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell.
This item includes 7 limited uses. The Determine Ounces activity can be used to determine the number of ounces equivalent to 1d6 + 1.
The Apply Glue activity allows you to select the number of ounces you're applying.
name: sovereign glue
